name: Buzzbox 827
summary: Along Darkshore's coast, Buzzbox 827 waits silent for repairs. Wizbang Cranktoggle built it as the first of a chain of voice relays, each made to use parts from local wildlife. Restoring it lets Wizbang test his network from Auberdine.

sections.title: Gnomish Innovation on Ancient Shores
sections.body: In Auberdine, gnomish engineer Wizbang Cranktoggle is trying to bridge Darkshore's wild coast with a chain of voice relays called Buzzboxes. Their levers and gears carry speech across great distances, a sharp contrast with the ancient ruins and somber forests around them. The machines break down often, and each needs constant care to keep working.

sections.title: Ecological Maintenance
sections.body: Buzzbox 827 lies on the misty shore just south of Auberdine. Wizbang built each relay to use parts from nearby wildlife, so repairs do not depend on carrying refined iron gears and copper pins through the wilderness. This unit takes the sturdy, jointed legs of local tide and reef crawlers. Put the legs in its receiver hopper, and the machine assembles itself and carries Wizbang's voice through its speakers.

faq.answer: A Buzzbox is a long-distance voice machine invented by the gnome Wizbang Cranktoggle. Its levers and inner workings carry voices across Darkshore, letting people speak over great distances.

faq.q: Why does a metal machine need crab legs to run?
faq.answer: Wizbang designed each Buzzbox to use parts from nearby wildlife as replacements. Buzzbox 827 sits near the beach crawlers, so travelers can repair it with their limbs instead of rare machined metal.
Buzzbox 827 is on the Darkshore shoreline, just south of Auberdine.
Wizbang Cranktoggle is a gnome tinkerer staying upstairs at the Auberdine inn. He is building a communication network across Darkshore, though his prototypes often fail.

faq.q: Where can I find Crawler Legs for the repair?
faq.answer: Pygmy Tide Crawlers and Young Reef Crawlers scuttle through the sands and shallows of the Darkshore beach just south of Auberdine. Their legs can repair the Buzzbox.

faq.q: What happens once Buzzbox 827 is repaired?
faq.answer: Feed the Crawler Legs into the hopper, and the machine churns them into place, hums to life, and carries Wizbang's voice from Auberdine. Pleased with the result, he asks you to go farther down the coast and repair Buzzbox 411.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see Wizbang's improvisation at work: he uses local chitin and arthropod limbs instead of forged brass gears, trading durability for parts that are easy to scavenge.
As a gnome, you can recognize Wizbang's ambition in his attempt to bring connected communication to an ancient, untamed land without telephones or radios.
As a night elf, you may find the clanking, smoking Buzzboxes an eyesore on Kalimdor's sacred, somber shores. The night elves of Auberdine tolerate the tinker's experiments.
